description: Declared mutants of the kernel spike (v8-arch-kernel-spike; docs/architecture/plans/kernel/spike-report.zh-Hant.md). A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message: a build failure for the compile-time checks (expect_build_failure), a failing doctest case otherwise. Configure the spike first (spikes/kernel/CMakeLists.txt), then run docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --build-dir <spike build dir> --catalog spikes/kernel/mutations.json.

mutants.what: ids no longer follow registration order (lookup returns the reverse index)
a type can be registered twice
mutants.expect: Registry: lookup does not create ids

mutants.what: Write<T> declares a read instead of a write
mutants.find:
using Reads = TypeList<>;
    using Writes = TypeList<Access<AccessKind::Component, T>>;
mutants.replace:
using Reads = TypeList<Access<AccessKind::Component, T>>;
    using Writes = TypeList<>;

mutants.what: Read<T> declares nothing
mutants.find:
using Reads = TypeList<Access<AccessKind::Component, T>>;
    using Writes = TypeList<>;
mutants.replace:
using Reads = TypeList<>;
    using Writes = TypeList<>;

mutants.what: Res<T> declares a component instead of a resource
ResMut<T> declares no write
EventReader<T> declares no read
EventWriter<T> declares no write
Deferred declares no write of the deferred queue
a noexcept free function is no longer deduced
a const member function is no longer deduced
aliasing (a key written twice, or read and written) is no longer detected
a parameter that is not a handle is accepted
run-time ids keep a repeated read twice
mutants.expect: Derivation: MakeSystem keeps the derived descriptor

mutants.what: Read<T> can be copied (and so kept past a run)
Write<T> can be constructed from a World by anyone
mutants.find:
friend struct ParamFactory;
    explicit Write(World& world) {

mutants.what: reads through the World are no longer checked against the descriptor
mutants.find: const bool declared = mode == AccessMode::Read ? system->DeclaresRead(key) || system->DeclaresWrite(key)
mutants.replace: const bool declared = mode == AccessMode::Read ? true

mutants.what: a declared read is accepted as a write
access to another World during a System run is not reported
mutants.find: KERNEL_SPIKE_ASSERT(Detail::runningWorld == this, "a System accessed a World it is not running on");

mutants.what: storage a System did not declare as written is not compared after the run
storage changed outside any System is not compared before the next run
host writes through the World API are reported as bypasses
mutants.expect: Control: host writes through the World API

mutants.what: the release (NDEBUG) build checks World access
mutants.expect: Build: the debug target checks World access

mutants.what: Integrate takes Read<Position> but still writes it (plain assignment)
Integrate takes Read<Position> and writes through const_cast
Heal drops Write<Health> and writes through const_cast
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check

mutants.what: Fall drops Res<Gravity> and reads it through a captured World
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check

mutants.what: Listen drops EventReader<Spawned> and reads the events through a captured World
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check

mutants.what: Listen drops ResMut<Stats> and writes it through a captured World
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check

mutants.what: Announce drops EventWriter<Spawned> and sends through a captured World
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check

mutants.what: Announce drops Deferred and queues through a captured World
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check

mutants.what: Measure drops Read<Position> and reads it through a captured World
mutants.expect: Control: declared reads and writes never trip the check
